* **Calculus I (MATH-1010U)**: Mobius Online Quiz #2 — **Monday, Sept 21 at 8:00 AM**

## Announcements

* **System Outage Notice**: **MyOntarioTech** will be offline from **Friday, Sept 25 at 5:00 PM to Monday, Sept 28 at 8:00 AM** for administrative upgrades.
* **Physics I (PHY-1010U)**:
  * **Tutorial Tests**: Start the week of Sept 21. Tests cover material from two weeks prior (Topic 1: Kinematics of Straight Line Motion). Check your personal weekly schedule on the Ontario Tech app to confirm whether your tutorial runs this week or next week.
  * **TA Contact**: TA Anika Annigeri requests to be emailed directly at `anika.annigeri@ontariotechu.net` instead of Canvas messaging.
  * **Group Assignment**: You have been assigned to group *Anika Annigeri - W2 - 40370 - Friday 5:10 PM*.
* **Linear Algebra (MATH-1850U)**:
  * **Row Reduction Review Sessions**: Held Sept 21 (10–11 AM, online), Sept 22 (11 AM–12 PM, SHA361), and Sept 23 (10–11 AM, online). Register via QuadC.
  * **Tutorial Prep**: Read the MATLAB guide/video under Week 2 Modules before Tutorial 2.
  * **Grading Policy**: If you score higher on Midterm #1 than your Week 2 Assessment, it will automatically replace your Week 2 Assessment grade.
* **Calculus I (MATH-1010U)**:
  * **Calculus Readiness Results**: Available Monday, Sept 21 at 8:00 AM in the Mobius gradebook.
* **Engineering Comm. and Tech. (CRN 46418)**:
  * Recurring Google Meet links were posted for Monday (2:10 PM) and Tuesday (1:10 PM) tutorial sections.
  * **Cancellation**: Friday 2:10 PM tutorials (CRNs 46371 & 46372) are cancelled until a TA is assigned.
* **Campus & Tools**:
  * **Google Gemini**: Enterprise version is now available to all students by logging in with university credentials.

---

## Worth a Second Look

* **Cut-off Email (Linear Algebra)**: The Sep 21 email regarding Week 2 Assessment scantron reviews cuts off mid-sentence ("*...you can come to special drop-in hours to view your questions+scantron to see which question*"). Check the Canvas announcement directly to read the full drop-in schedule.
* **Incomplete Email**: An email sent on Sep 18 with the subject "pt. 2" was incomplete ("*...orial this is our email aft... Wait for next email*"). Verify if a follow-up email was received or needs a response.
* **Mobius Quiz Access**: Math professors recommend accessing Mobius online quizzes via Firefox on a desktop/laptop (avoid iPads) if you encounter loading issues.
* **Health & Dental Plan Opt-Out**: If you plan to opt out of student health/dental benefits, the deadline is **Wednesday, September 30** via [otsu.ca/healthplan](https://otsu.ca/healthplan).
